items.title: IMAX (IMAX) CEO Defends Offering Premium Screens To A High Profile Streaming Release
items.summary: IMAX (NYSE:IMAX) CEO publicly addressed decisions by major theater chains to forgo showing a high profile Netflix film on IMAX screens. The chief executive said the company had offered IMAX auditoriums for the Netflix title while some exhibition partners held back. Management framed the episode as part of broader talks with studios and streaming platforms over how premium screens are allocated.
